cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Orders from the Shadows
cards.instruction: Hide that you set the problem in motion while quietly directing how everyone responds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I'll rebuild the wedding bookings. Could you reassure the couples?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cancellation log has your initials.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Keep that screen here. Give them the replacement dates; I'll handle the log.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can restore everything, but they'll get an email naming whoever cancelled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's helpful. Restore the dates individually instead; I'll stay and read them out.

mechanism: A copies a confident procedure without understanding it, hides that this caused the problem, and directs a repair that conceals A involvement.
confusable: D62 hides legitimacy of authority; D61 hides originating responsibility while directing the response.
comparison: Misrouted crates and management timeline versus cancelled bookings and an identifying restoration email.
seedUse: Preserve the corrected-address and individual-restoration choices as B-induced concealment tactics.
